changes_data.diff:
@@ -17,6 +17,7 @@ set( EXT_ASN_FILE_LIST
 set( ASN_FILE_LIST
 	${PROTOCOL_NAME}.asn
 	PKCS5v2-1.asn
+	Module-scrypt-0.asn
 )
 
 set( EXTRA_DIST

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+-- Extracted from RFC 7914
+
+-- scrypt ASN.1 Module
+
+Module-scrypt-0 {1 3 6 1 4 1 11591 4 10}
+
+DEFINITIONS ::= BEGIN
+
+IMPORTS
+  ALGORITHM-IDENTIFIER
+    FROM PKCS5v2-1 -- [RFC2898]
+      { iso(1) member-body(2) us(840) rsadsi(113549)
+        pkcs(1) pkcs-5(5) modules(16) pkcs5v2-0(1) } ;
+
+id-scrypt OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= {1 3 6 1 4 1 11591 4 11}
+
+Scrypt-params ::= SEQUENCE {
+    salt OCTET STRING,
+    costParameter INTEGER (1..MAX),
+    blockSize INTEGER (1..MAX),
+    parallelizationParameter INTEGER (1..MAX),
+    keyLength INTEGER (1..MAX) OPTIONAL
+}
+
+PBES2-KDFs ALGORITHM-IDENTIFIER ::=
+       { {Scrypt-params IDENTIFIED BY id-scrypt}, ... }
+
+END

@@ -47,6 +47,8 @@ PBKDF2-params		B "1.2.840.113549.1.5.12" "id-PBKDF2"
 PBES2-params		B "1.2.840.113549.1.5.13" "id-PBES2"
 PBMAC1-params		B "1.2.840.113549.1.5.14" "id-PBMAC1"
 
+Scrypt-params		B "1.3.6.1.4.1.11591.4.11" "id-scrypt"
+
 #.NO_EMIT
 
 #.TYPE_RENAME
